exposure: Maternal blood pressure (normotensive vs. chronic hypertension)
cohort: 236 singleton pregnant women (203 low-risk and 33 with chronic hypertension) scheduled for elective Cesarean section
finding: In women with stage-1 chronic hypertension at term, spinal anesthesia for Cesarean section reduced uterine artery impedance but not umbilical artery impedance.
mod_finding: In women with stage-1 chronic hypertension at term, spinal anesthesia for Cesarean section reduced uterine artery impedance but not umbilical artery impedance.
